comment: The method sentence each public README must carry, word for word, as the owner wrote it (15 November 2026). tests/test_build_public_tree.py checks the rendered READMEs against these.
en: The code was written with an AI coding agent under the author's direction. Every change was reviewed by the author through pull requests, tests and guards.
tr: Kod, yazarın yönetiminde bir yapay zekâ kodlama ajanıyla yazıldı. Her değişiklik pull request'ler, testler ve bekçiler üzerinden yazarın incelemesinden geçti.
